IncidentDef.label: Tok'ra hidden safehouse marker
IncidentDef.letterText: Your colonists have traced enough of a stored Tok'ra safehouse lead to mark a possible clandestine safehouse on the world map. The location is still incomplete and cannot be entered yet, but it proves that the hidden channel can point to a real place. One safehouse lead was consumed. Remaining safehouse leads: {LEADCOUNT}/{LEADMAX}.
